claims: Transition and magnet regions support quantization; offset is a distinct destination-position property.
None reaches the destination start. Relative preserves distance from the source region start in bars, including differing BPM with the same time signature.

conditions: Two four-bar sections A/B, same4/4, quarter-note beat.
A120BPM, B90BPM; transition source and destination region origins aligned with their sections; no transition timeline.
Jump happens at A third-bar start, a two-bar offset.
results: None maps to B first-bar start.
Relative maps to B third-bar start.
A two bars=4seconds; B two bars=16/3seconds. Source elapsed seconds are not copied.
